summary.text: Israel O'Quinn is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 44, which covers Washington County, part of Russell County, and the City of Bristol.
Israel O'Quinn has been a member since 2012.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Israel O'Quinn was born in Abingdon, Virginia, in 1980.
Israel O'Quinn studied at Emory & Henry University (B.A., 2002).
Israel O'Quinn's listed occupation is foundation president and CEO.

Israel O'Quinn's listed memberships and affiliations include the Emory & Henry College Board of Trustees, the Bristol Chamber of Commerce (former chairman), the Bipartisan Policy Center's Appalachian Initiative Task Force, the Southwest Virginia Higher Education Center (former chairman), InvestSWVA (co-chair), the VA-Ireland Legislators Caucus (co-chair), and the Virginia Private College's Caucus (co-chair).
The profile lists Emily O'Quinn as Israel O'Quinn's spouse.
The House profile lists Israel O'Quinn's committee assignments as Privileges and Elections, Labor and Commerce, Rules, and Transportation.
